steps.tip: Mountaineer Stormpike stands in Algaz Station, the first outpost after the tunnel from Dun Morogh. You come back here after the mine.

steps.text: Follow the road south to Thelsamar: turn in Stout to Kadrell to Mountaineer Kadrell and accept Rat Catching and Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

steps.tip: All three ingredients drop around Algaz Station in the north: Mountain Boars, Elder Black Bears and Forest Lurkers.
Brock's list sends you on a gryphon round trip to Ironforge. Keep it until you have other business there.

steps.text: Accept Snowbound from Grenhild Darktalon and take the Jar of Snow
Keep the Jar of Snow for Norric Lochthane on the northwest shore
Get the Thelsamar flight path from Thorgrum Borrelson
Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Hearthstove in Thelsamar

steps.tip: The southern guard tower is on the road to the Badlands, southwest of Thelsamar.

steps.text: Shamans: turn in Call of Fire to Braldir Ashmantle below the Shrine of Eternal Flame and accept the next part
steps.tip: The Reagent Pouch drops from Stonesplinter Seers here; the Fire Tar comes from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the Silver Stream Mine later.
Stonesplinter Troggs and Scouts fill the valley mouth east of the tower.

steps.speed: You get most of the teeth from the 20 troggs you kill anyway.

steps.text: Turn in In Defense of the King's Lands to Mountaineer Cobbleflint and accept the next part from Mountaineer Gravelgaw

steps.tip: Skullthumpers stand deeper in Stonesplinter Valley; Seers are on the hill near the shrine. Seers heal, so kill them first.

steps.text: Turn in In Defense of the King's Lands to Gravelgaw and accept the last part from Mountaineer Wallbang
steps.tip: The Shaman and Bonesnapper troggs for this one are level 15-16. Come back for them later.

segments.title: Algaz and the Silver Stream Mine

steps.text: Kill Mountain Boars south of Algaz Station for 3 Boar Intestines
Kill Elder Black Bears in the hills north of Algaz for 3 Bear Meat
Kill Forest Lurkers in the woods by Algaz for 3 Spider Ichor

steps.tip: The Tunnel Rats are outside and inside the Silver Stream Mine. Geomancers cast fire, so interrupt or burst them.

steps.text: Shamans: loot Fire Tar from the Tunnel Rat Geomancers

steps.tip: Miners' League crates sit along the mine tunnels. Clear the rats around each crate first.

steps.text: Back at Algaz Station, turn in Filthy Paws and Mountaineer Stormpike's Task to Mountaineer Stormpike, then accept Stormpike's Order
steps.tip: Stormpike's Order is a letter for Stormwind. This guide ends there on the way to Redridge, so just keep it.

steps.text: Deliver the Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane's house on the northwest shore of the loch
Walk down the shore and pick up the Discarded Fishing Toolbox to start Silver of the Waves
steps.tip: New in Forever. The toolbox lies on the beach northeast of Thelsamar.

steps.text: Return the hair clip to Khara Deepwater at the fishing dock north of Thelsamar
Turn in Rat Catching to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar
Train if you have new spells; the nearest trainers are in Ironforge, or the Hunter trainer at the Farstrider Lodge

segments.title: The Farstrider Lodge and the eastern shore

steps.tip: Prospector Ironband's camp is at the excavation on the southeast shore. Follow the road east along the south of the loch.
The Farstrider Lodge is the hunting lodge in the far east. Marek gives both crocolisk quests.
15-minute timer. Mountain Buzzards circle the hills just south of the lodge.

steps.text: Turn in A Hunter's Boast to Daryl the Youngling and accept A Hunter's Challenge
steps.tip: Only accept the challenge when you are ready to go; the timer is 12 minutes.
Elder Mountain Boars roam the hills northwest of the lodge. They are level 16-17, so eat between pulls.
Daggerfang is a named crocolisk that swims along the east shore of the loch; check the water between Bingles' camp and the lodge.
Loch Crocolisks crowd the east shore. Stay out of deep water so you do not pull two at once.
Bingles camps on the east shore. His tools are scattered along the north shore near the dam, which you reach later.

steps.text: Turn in Crocolisk Hunting and Twisting the Knife to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge
Hearth back to Thelsamar
steps.speed: The walk back west is long; always hearth here.

steps.text: Turn in Excavation Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm
Give Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson at the Thelsamar gryphon post, accept Ride to Ironforge and fly to Ironforge
Bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in the Great Forge and accept Gryth Thurden
Give the picks to Gryth Thurden, the Ironforge gryphon master, and accept Return to Brock
Turn in Report to Ironforge to Prospector Stormpike in the Hall of Explorers and accept Powder to Ironband
Warriors: bring the Umbral Ore to Tormus Deepforge in the Great Forge, then accept and turn in Grey Iron Weapons for your weapon

steps.tip: Paladins: this starts the Redemption quest line. It ends at Narm Faulk in eastern Dun Morogh, so you walk back to Loch Modan instead of flying.

steps.text: Paladins: talk to Tiza Battleforge in the Mystic Ward and take the Tome of Divinity
Paladins: read the Tome of Divinity, hand it to Tiza Battleforge and accept the next part
Paladins: find John Turner in the outer ring of Ironforge
Paladins: give John Turner 10 Linen Cloth from your bags and accept the next part
Paladins: return to Tiza Battleforge
Paladins: take the Symbol of Life to Muiredon Battleforge and accept the next part

steps.tip: New Forever dungeon under Ironforge. Pick this up now and run it at the end of Loch Modan, on your way to the tram.

steps.text: Fly back to Thelsamar
Fly back to Thelsamar
Paladins: walk out of Ironforge to Narm Faulk's body by Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh and use the Symbol of Life on him
Paladins: turn in The Tome of Divinity to Narm Faulk and accept the next part

steps.tip: The Dark Iron Spies around Ironband's Compound drop the script. Then take the tunnel at the South Gate back into Loch Modan.

steps.text: Turn in Return to Brock to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar
Turn in Powder to Ironband to Jern Hornhelm and accept Resupplying the Excavation
Find Huldar at the ambushed cart on the road to the excavation, turn in Resupplying the Excavation and accept After the Ambush
Talk to Miran next to Huldar and accept Protecting the Shipment
steps.tip: Troggs ambush the cart once you start. Keep Miran alive; the Dark Iron dwarves do not hit hard.

steps.text: Turn in Protecting the Shipment to Prospector Ironband at the excavation
Turn in Ironband's Excavation to Magmar Fellhew and accept Gathering Idols

steps.tip: New in Forever. Loot any Excavation Tools pile in the dig site to start this.
The idol troggs in the dig site are level 17-19. Pull one at a time and leave if it gets crowded.

steps.text: Shamans: turn in the Fire Tar and Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle and accept the next Call of Fire

steps.tip: The Minor Manifestation of Fire waits at the shrine on the hill above Braldir.

steps.text: Shamans: place the Glowing Ember in the brazier and accept the last part, which ends at Bruegs Kindleborn by the Dun Morogh South Gate

steps.tip: Stonesplinter Shamans are deep in the valley; Bonesnappers stand on the northern slopes toward the loch.

steps.text: Turn in In Defense of the King's Lands to Mountaineer Wallbang

steps.tip: New in Forever. Mountaineer Ylva is at the south end of the valley, near Grawmug's camp.
Raise the banner and Headsplitter comes to you. Clear nearby troggs first.
Grawmug and his two guards are together at the back of the valley. Pull a guard first if you can, or bring a friend.

steps.text: Turn in In Defense of the King's Lands and Banner of the Fallen to Captain Rugelfuss at the southern guard tower
steps.speed: The Thelsamar spirit healer is close to the dam road. If you are low after Grawmug, a death walks you most of the way north.

steps.text: If you are not level 16 yet, kill Stonesplinter Bonesnappers on the valley's north slopes until you are
steps.tip: The dam quests need level 16.
Chief Engineer Hinderweir stands on top of the Stonewrought Dam at the north end of the loch.

steps.text: Search the eastern ramp of the dam for the Suspicious Barrel, turn in A Dark Threat Looms and accept the next part
Bring the clue back to Chief Engineer Hinderweir
steps.tip: The chain continues into the Wetlands. Leave it for now; you go to Redridge next.
The tool buckets are near the north shore just south of the dam; the Blastencapper is the furthest east.

steps.text: Bring the tools back to Bingles Blastenheimer on the east shore
Grind Elder Mountain Boars and Black Bear Patriarchs in the hills east of the loch until level 17
steps.tip: Loch Modan runs out of solo quests around level 16. With dungeons on, the Hall of Thanes quests in Ironforge cover this instead.
steps.speed: Grind only what you are missing; Redridge's first quests start at 15-17, so a little short is fine.

segments.title: Ironforge and the Hall of Thanes

steps.text: Hearth back to Thelsamar
steps.speed: If the hearth is still on cooldown, ride; do not wait for it.

steps.text: Shamans: walk through the Algaz tunnel and give the Torch to Bruegs Kindleborn just past the Dun Morogh South Gate, then continue to Ironforge on foot
Fly from Thelsamar to Ironforge
Paladins: give the Dark Iron Script to Muiredon Battleforge, then report to Tiza Battleforge
Train in Ironforge
steps.tip: When you are done in Ironforge, take the Deeprun Tram from Tinker Town to Stormwind.
Speak with Shoni sends you to Stormwind, where the tram drops you anyway.

steps.text: Run the Hall of Thanes: kill the Enraged Apparitions and Tormented Souls for The Restless Dead
steps.tip: The dungeon is reached from Old Ironforge below the city. Level 15 or higher is comfortable.

steps.text: Loot 8 Dwarven Heirlooms in the Hall of Thanes
Talk to the Ghostly Attendant inside, put Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and report back to the Attendant
Kill Durgen Dirgehammer, the last boss, for his head
Read the Treaty of Understanding tablet in the last vault to start the quest
steps.tip: Everyone has to loot the tablet themselves; it cannot be shared.

steps.text: Bring Durgen's head and the Treaty to King Magni Bronzebeard in the High Seat

steps.tip: Afadra waits at the camp west of Kharanos. It is a walk, so skip it if you are in a hurry to reach Redridge.

steps.text: Ride the Deeprun Tram to Stormwind and deliver Stormpike's Order to Furen Longbeard in the Dwarven District
Turn in Speak with Shoni to Shoni the Shilent in the Dwarven District
steps.tip: Her follow-up is a Gnomeregan quest for later.

steps.text: Priests: turn in Desperate Prayer to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light
Warlocks: turn in The Slaughtered Lamb to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter
steps.tip: Gakin's next quest, Surena Caledon, gets you the Voidwalker in Elwynn Forest.
